brief.prompt: Recreate the viral $150 high-end video edit from Instagram reel with Manoj Bajpayee rotoscoped raw footage using EME engine
brief.creativeGoal: Deliver motion design kinetic typography, 3D cutout sandwich depth text, split-screen storytelling, pulsating anatomical graphics, and punchy audio riser synchronization
brief.targetAudience: Short-form video creators, editors, and social media audiences
brief.referenceStyle: Top-tier Instagram motion edit ($150 edit) featuring editorial palettes (#701023 Crimson & #f6f0e2 Cream), Archivo Black / Instrument Serif typography, and cinematic b-roll montage

sourceReferences.analysisSummary: 1080x1920 30fps green-screen rotoscoped studio footage of actor Manoj Bajpayee during interview
48kHz stereo master audio track with pristine dialogue, sound design risers, sub whooshes, and subtle background score
High-contrast editorial serif italic for expressive kinetic words (will, mistakes)
Heavy display sans-serif typeface for dominant impact titles (Many, IMPROVE, HUMAN BEIGN)
Geometric sans-serif for structured navigation top bar (MISTAKES, HARDWORK, CONSISTENCY) and badge cards

sequenceStructure.name: Act 1: Mistakes Hook & Kinetic Type
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Establish deep crimson backdrop, top navigation bar, and kinetic pop-in of 'All off us will make mistakes'

sequenceStructure.name: Act 2: Cream Architectural Grid & Expanding Banner
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Transition to tactile cream grid, animating maroon horizontal banner 'I have made many' with italic 'mistakes'

sequenceStructure.name: Act 3: Cutout Sandwich Depth Effect
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Sandwich Manoj Bajpayee between 5 stacked background solid 'Many' titles and foreground 4px white outline titles

sequenceStructure.name: Act 4: 3-Tier Split Screen Cinematic B-Roll
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Full canvas three-tier montage (Truman sky wall, vintage cinema projector, and snowy warrior) synchronized to 'KOI DOODH KA DHULA HUA NAHI HAI'

sequenceStructure.name: Act 5: Red Sun Circle & Chest IMPROVE Banner
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Crimson framing circle behind head, solid crimson chest banner with bold white 'IMPROVE' and Hindi subtitles

sequenceStructure.name: Act 6: Anatomical Pulsing Heart & Canvas Texture
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: 3D illuminated heart pulsating under top spotlight with textured canvas overlay 'THERE'S A LOT OF WORK GOING ON'

sequenceStructure.name: Act 7: Crimson Climax & HUMAN BEIGN Accent
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Crimson background, red accent bar across chest, and high-impact 'TO BE A GOOD HUMAN BEIGN' typography

sequenceStructure.name: Act 8: Background Pill Popups & Outro
sequenceStructure.narrativeIntent: Sliding pill cards positioned behind Manoj's head and microphone delivering final Hindi punchlines ('Jaruri hai')
